# testaruda

> Language-agnostic, recall-first affected-test selection from code changes.

testaruda persists a dependency graph, computes changed content units, and
selects tests through an embedded Ascent query. Rust and Python adapters ship
with the package; the Julia adapter is provided by Testimonial.jl.

## User documentation

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): installation, initialization,
  discovery, first selection, and safe CI mode.
- [CLI reference](docs/cli.md): generated command and option reference.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): supported `testaruda.toml` fields,
  defaults, adapters, and safety rules.
- [Agent mode](docs/agent-mode.md): structured `--agent` and `--pre-edit`
  output contracts.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): current components and selection path.

## Integration contracts

- [Adapter protocol](docs/adapter-protocol.md): JSON-lines subprocess protocol.
- [Agent output schema](schemas/agent-output-v1.json): `--agent` JSON Schema.
- [Pre-edit output schema](schemas/pre-edit-output-v1.json): `--pre-edit` JSON Schema.
- [Software requirements](docs/tia-srs-ears.md): draft normative requirements;
  requirements are not evidence that every capability is implemented.

## Contributor documentation

- [Contributing](docs/contributing.md): local checks and contribution workflow.
- [Python adapter edge cases](docs/adapter-python-edge-cases.md): dated engineering
  audit, not a user-facing behavior guarantee.
- [Evaluation reports](docs/evaluations/README.md): historical implementation
  evaluations; consult their dates and retest sections before using findings.
